description: This shell script contains platform-specific functions for Mikrotik devices in OpenWrt firmware, including image validation, upgrade procedures for NAND flashes, and device identification.

methods.name: platform_check_image_mikrotik_nor
methods.description: Checks the bootloader version and boot entry to validate the image for Mikrotik devices

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines if the image is suitable for the device based on the device's board name

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs upgrade steps for Mikrotik NAND devices including extracting kernel and flashing

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that dispatches to specific NAND or NOR upgrade routines based on device type
